  AVG(ua.stage_of_extraction_pct) AS stage_of_extraction_pct
FROM 
  unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
  assessment_units u ON u.unit_id = ua.unit_id
JOIN 
  districts d ON d.district_id = u.district_id
JOIN 
  states s ON s.state_id = u.state_id

  s.state_name = 'ARUNACHAL PRADESH'
  AND ua.assessment_year = '2019-2020'

  ROUND(COUNT(DISTINCT ua.unit_id) * 100.0 / su.n_units, 2) AS percentage_over_exploited
FROM 
  unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
  assessment_units u ON ua.unit_id = u.unit_id
JOIN 
  districts d ON u.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
  states s ON d.state_id = s.state_id
JOIN 
  state_unit_granularity su ON s.state_id = su.state_id AND ua.assessment_year = su.assessment_year
WHERE 
  UPPER(s.state_name) = 'Sikkim' 
  AND ua.assessment_year = '2019-2020'
  AND ua.category = 'Over-Exploited'

    state_assessments sa

    assessment_years ay ON sa.assessment_year = ay.assessment_year

    states s ON sa.state_id = s.state_id

    state_assessments sa2 ON sa.state_id = sa2.state_id

    assessment_years ay2 ON sa2.assessment_year = ay2.assessment_year
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'BIHAR' 
    AND ay.assessment_year = '2022-2023'
    AND ay2.assessment_year = '2019-2020'

    (sa.stage_of_extraction_pct - sa2.stage_of_extraction_pct) AS stage_of_extraction_pct_diff

SELECT 
    d.district_name,
    SUM(CASE WHEN ua.category = 'Over-Exploited' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS over_exploited_unit_count,
    SUM(ua.extraction_irrigation_ham) AS irrigation_extraction_ham
FROM 
    unit_assessments ua
JOIN 
    assessment_units u ON ua.unit_id = u.unit_id
JOIN 
    districts d ON u.district_id = d.district_id
JOIN 
    states s ON d.state_id = s.state_id
WHERE 
    s.state_name = 'RAJASTHAN'
    AND ua.assessment_year = '2022-2023'
GROUP BY 
    d.district_name
ORDER BY 
    over_exploited_unit_count DESC
LIMIT 3

    irrigation_extraction_ham DESC
LIMIT 1
